item.title: UW’s Art Lofts open “Ghost Writer: someone who writes something for someone else”
item.description: UW’s Art Lofts Main Gallery opened “Ghost Writer: Someone Who Writes Something for Someone Else” on Feb. 4, 2026. item.title: Dr. Eric Wilcots named UW-Madison’s new interim chancellor, effective May 17
